gemini-api-key-page.note: The endpoint takes the key in `x-goog-api-key`, as ADR 0073 §5 names and the S54d assembly recorded.

generate-content-contract.note: The `:generateContent` request the implemented shape assembles (S54d): `POST .../{model=models/*}:generateContent` with `{ systemInstruction?, contents, generationConfig? }`.

gemini-text-answer-docs.note: Each model page states Supported data types Output `Text` (1,048,576 input / 65,536 output tokens). The generateContent reference states `POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/{model=models/*}:generateContent` (not marked deprecated), `Candidate.content` "Generated content returned from the model", `Content.parts` "Ordered Parts that constitute a single message" and `Part.text` "Inline text". It names `usageMetadata.thoughtsTokenCount` but not whether `candidatesTokenCount` includes it, so usage attribution stays undeclared. Documentation is not per-account availability or live proof.

routes.note: The endpoint is the models collection: the shape addresses the model in the path and appends `:generateContent`. `generationConfig` is optional, so the route names no cap and sends no such key.

openQuestions: The limit reading is not established: no page read states the shape of this endpoint's rate-limit or account-limit response, so a 429 is read as a retryable rate limit (`rate-limit-retryable`, `unverified`) until a page or a named live item says otherwise.

A shape discrepancy, recorded rather than resolved (ADR 0080 §3): the pages read on 2026-09-10 describe an Interactions-style API (`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions`, `response_format`, typed `steps`), while the implemented `google-generate-content` shape assembles the older `:generateContent` request, which the vendor documentation no longer states. This document binds nothing until a shape review establishes which API the endpoint serves today, and no Gemini binding carries a web-search-enabled rule before it.

Read again on 2026-10-31 (Issue #1225): https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content states `POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/{model=models/*}:generateContent`, not marked deprecated, and its response's `candidates[].content.parts[].text`; the text answer is declared on that reading. The Interactions-style shape question above stays recorded for tools, structured output and search.
Grounding with Google Search (`google_search`) is documented on the Interactions-style pages; it is declared absent here because the shape it is documented on is not the one this route speaks.
